# CC Babysitter

> Keeps Claude Code sessions alive and reachable. If the app running a babysat session (Claude Desktop, VS Code or a terminal) closes, crashes or is killed, CC Babysitter starts the same session again in the background with Remote Control on, so it stays reachable from a phone. Where the system allows it, CC Babysitter itself runs in the background and starts again at login, or at boot on a headless server, where it runs as a user service, so babysat sessions survive SSH drops and reboots. Free, open source (MIT), for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Install

- macOS and Linux: `curl -fsSL https://ccbabysitter.dev/install.sh | sh`
- Windows: `irm https://ccbabysitter.dev/install.ps1 | iex`
- Go: `go install ccbabysitter.dev/ccbabysitter/cmd/ccbabysitter@latest`

## Use it from an AI agent

- `ccbabysitter babysit self`: keep the Claude Code session the command runs in alive
- `ccbabysitter list --json`: every session on the machine, as JSON
- `ccbabysitter --help`: all commands, and `ccbabysitter help <command>` for one
